title: dumpcap: determine the application flavor before we use it.
description:
Use ws_getopt_long() to do the initial argument parsing for the -Z flag,
and handle the --application-flavor option there as well.

Reset the argument parsing before we make the main ws_getopt_long()
call.

Don't do anything for either -Z or --application-flavor in the main
ws_getopt_long() call, as it's already been done.

Suppress the usage message for those options, as they aren't in the
usage message, and that message is so long it may scroll the original
error message off the screen. Note that we should probably suppress most
of the usage message for *all* option-specific errors, as only the
message about the option in question is relevant.

Get rid of a no-longer-used loop index variable - and make another loop
index variable internal to the loop (C99-and-successors for the win!),
and rename it to "i" as there's no longer an existing "i" variable with
which it would collide.

Fix #21332.
